games.name: Etranger In the City of Doom
The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM!
Dad's Gonna Be a Travel Influencer.
Dad’s Gonna Be a Travel Influencer.
Misblood
games.summary:
Misblood is an arcade-style top-down shooter built around short, brutal, replayable missions. The city has a list of 25 contracts with your name on it: drive to the address, kick the door, and fight room by room until nobody is left standing. You are always outnumbered, deaths come fast, and restarts come faster — every mission is a plan you rewrite on the fly.

Fight with whatever the job hands you: pistol, rifle, shotgun or bat, backed by grenades and a split-second dash.

An open pixel-art city to cruise between jobs, and a list that only ends one way.

games.name: ゾンビポリス ～ゾンビ刑事と凍てつく真夏のお正月～ Soundtrack
Beyond the Masque of the Red Death
games.summary: Explore a gothic, macabre environment and find objects of symbolic significance, in this text-based adventure game inspired by "The Masque of the Red Death" by Edgar Allan Poe. Interact by typing your intentions in text, in an authentically written story that goes Beyond where the original one ends.

games.name: Cat Survivor
games.summary: Cat Survivor is a minefield auto-battler where mines become your greatest weapon. Read the numbers, place your flags, trigger explosive chain reactions, and wipe out entire hordes. Win with strategy, not brute force.

games.name: DeepBreaker
games.summary: Break through solid rock with your bare hands. Smash blocks, upgrade your power at the Workbench, unlock stronger gloves, fight enemies, and uncover what lies beyond the walls.

games.name: Deepest Maze
games.summary: Explore a cursed labyrinth filled with deadly monsters and hidden treasures. Defeat enemies, level up, master skills, and collect gear. Recruit NPCs as companions, fight powerful foes, overcome countless dangers, and reach the deepest depths!

games.name: Final Kick Football Legends
games.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

games.name: Gorse Roll
games.summary: Steer a ray-traced glass marble along floating roads of ice, mirrors and spinning floors. Race the clock through five worlds, hunt hidden sun crystals to earn a sixth, then build your own courses in an editor that traces every change as you make it.

games.name: Heya! Sumo Manager
games.summary: Heya! Sumo Manager allows you to manage a sumo stable and develop the skills of your rikishi on their road to Yokozuna! Climb from Jonokuchi to Sekitori by organizing the diet, training and tactics of your wrestlers and see them compete in 3D matches.

games.name: How to grow a man · 7-Character Epilogue DLC
IcerKid
games.summary: Welcome to IcerKid! Dive into a chilly, fast-paced puzzle-action adventure where your goal is to survive and conquer dynamic levels. Strategy, control, and thinking skills are required to advance to higher levels and compete on global leaderboards.

games.name: KAREI - ENDLESS DEATH MATCH
games.summary: A grid-based, turn-based puzzle roguelike. Play a lone kunoichi ascending an endless castle — read each floor like a puzzle, arm yourself from its walls, and cut down the oni in your path. One wrong move ends your run.

games.name: Keep The Ammo Flowing
games.summary: A top-down incremental logistics and tower-defense game. Mine resources, produce ammunition, build tracks toward the exit, and upgrade your mobile furnace and turret while defending it from underground swarms.

games.name: Little Lua & The Lost Six
games.summary: Six kids are torn from their world and dropped into Everbloom, a realm poisoned by the Blight. Build your squad, master fire, ice, and lightning magic, and fight your way through shifting seasons to free everyone the Blight has taken — including your own parents.

games.name: Neon & Bones
games.summary: Las Vegas, 1957. Every night you split the casino's take four ways: the tax man, Chicago, your crew and your own pocket. Skim too little and the Family sends a car; too much and the FBI opens a file. Build an empire, then buy your way out.

games.name: Night Wash: GE-418-NK
games.summary: Night shift at a tunnel car wash on the edge of town. Take the money, log the plates, keep the brushes turning until six. The attendant before you stopped coming three weeks ago. His notes are still in the drawer.

games.name: Party Home: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Clean up after the party in this cozy first-person co-op game! Put every item back where it belongs, scrub away the stains, toss the trash and play satisfying mini-games – solo or with a friend, online or split-screen – before Mom gets home.

games.name: Ravenhill: Initiation
games.summary: After a bitter argument with Hannah, Ethan vanishes while auditing files in quarantined Ravenhill Valley. When police refuse to enter the restricted zone, Hannah ventures into the fog-drenched woods to find her boyfriend. What she uncovers is an ancient threat and an ever-shifting nightmare reality.

games.name: Token Club: AI Desktop Pet
games.summary: A desktop pet for people who code with AI. When you prompt your agent (Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity), your mascot runs to the stage and dances while customers throw bills worth what that prompt costs at API prices.

games.name: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
Ancient Moves: Hnefatafl (Viking Chess)
games.summary: Command the siege or lead a royal escape in Ancient Moves: Hnefatafl, a Viking strategy board game. Capture the king with 24 attackers or break through with 12 defenders and their king. Play solo against four AI difficulty levels or challenge a friend on the same device or online.

games.name: Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn
Aspect Arena
games.summary: Inspired by The Walking Dead.Zombie Apocalypse is here and walkers are everywhere.There is nowhere to hide and the only way to survive is to kill the dead before they get to you and eat your brains.Brace yourself and survive the long night of the undead. Watch out for zombies from all directions.Don't forget to reload for a gun without ammo is just a club.WARNING! This game is not for the faint hearted.

games.name: Blendead
games.summary: Find me. I'm right in front of you. A multiplayer blend-and-seek where you pose as an NPC in a crowd — one mistake and you're dead.

games.name: Bouture
games.summary: Pot little living plants on your Windows desktop. They grow while you work, droop when they're thirsty and bloom after weeks of care. Water them, take cuttings and fill your herbarium: a calm companion that lives behind your windows, or above them.

games.name: Catch the Button
games.summary: A chaotic reaction game where every single click counts! Chase the moving button, build insane streaks, survive unpredictable events and watch out for tricks. Think you're fast enough to catch it?

games.name: Christmas Market: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: The Christmas feast is over and the harbour market is buried in mess of 3486 objects. Join up to 8 friends as the Night Crew of cozy elves, carry armfuls of plates, baubles and gingerbread back where they belong, and have the snowy market sparkling before sunrise.

games.name: Click the Stone: Active Incremental and Idler Demo
Dungeon Troll
games.summary: A 2D platformer for two players online. Jump, dodge and survive a dungeon packed with sneaky traps while you and your friend race to see who gets further. Only one walks away the winner.

games.name: Escape the Baby Alarm
games.summary:
Escape the Baby Alarm is a cozy, escape room-inspired puzzle game that explores the chaos and love of becoming a new parent. 

Built from my own experience, the game is a love letter to parenthood. An era defined by love and connection, but also extreme sleep deprivation, questionable hygiene standards, and the superpower of functioning on 2% battery with a baby in one hand and a cold coffee in the other.

games.name: Fantasy Auction House
games.summary: Start with 10 gold and trade your way to a fortune. Browse a fantasy auction house, spot underpriced goods, set your own resale prices and collect sales by mail. Merchants from across the world keep the listings changing.

games.name: Femme Fury(Pure Classic Simple Action Game)
Flock Hunt
games.summary: A first-person stealth game about taking down mass surveillance cameras and fighting a dystopian future. Every camera you break brings The Flock a little closer. Sneak out at night and destroy cameras with a growing arsenal of tools, sell camera scrap for upgrades, and hire a crew.

games.name: Follyvale
games.summary: A wordless hidden-object puzzle game set inside living medieval paintings. Find what the villagers need, carry it across the scene and set their troubles right, and each one you mend brings the picture into full colour. No timers, no way to fail, and the Fool to help or sometimes get in your way.

games.name: Frame343
games.summary: At a small data recovery firm you restore the camera of a man missing since 2011, at his sister's request. File 343 is missing. Dark records appear only while you hold Develop. But the camera is looking for a face, and when it finds one, it shoots. Short horror built on real photos and timestamps.

games.name: Friendly Mining Company
games.summary: A pixelated idle clicker about taking planets apart, layer by layer. Build a combo, buy a fleet, automate the grind, and push through a galaxy that for now seems devoid of life... Or is it?

games.name: Glowmonkey2k
games.summary: Fight through a corrupted digital world as Glowmonkey, switching weapons on the fly to defeat enemies immune to the wrong attack.

games.name: GNOMINAL
games.summary: $50,000 in debt. Clock in each night and shoot garden gnomes for the cash inside, but every bullet is billed to your balance. When the horn sounds, clock out with your takings, or stay for overtime—bigger payouts, bigger losses.

games.name: Goblin Island
games.summary: Grow, water, and harvest your way to riches in this farming incremental game. Create your goblin and walk around a living garden, chase rare mutations, hire goblin companions, and build your farm business from a humble plot into a goblin empire.

games.name: Goldbar In A S***stack
games.summary: There is one gold bar hidden inside a gigantic pile of s***. No clues. Dig it out by hand, hire an army of idiots, survive flying cows, UFOs and the foot of God, and scale up from a dog's little business to a planet made of 200 million chunks.

games.name: Hoard (Radikate)
games.summary: Two goblins, six worlds, and a dragon's hoard at the end of the road. Forge keys, crack open chests, dodge (or slay) the mimics, and pour your gold into upgrades and goblin helpers. A short, funny idle adventure where every chest could be loot... or teeth.

games.name: Huex
games.summary: A hex-grid line puzzle. Drag lines across the board until every hex is covered. Play a new puzzle every day, work through the stages, or build your own and share it with friends. Simple rules, challenging puzzles.

games.name: Idle Game Dev Studio
games.summary: Run your own game studio in this idle management game. Develop and release games, automate the work, and turn your growing catalog into steady income. Give flops another chance, build sequels, then sell your studio for permanent bonuses and start again.

games.name: Internet Cafe 98
games.summary: Start with one trash PC and build a packed 1998 internet cafe. Serve customers, upgrade your hardware and network, and research new tech in this retro incremental tycoon.

games.name: Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler
games.summary: Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands. As an expedition engineer, you’ll explore a peaceful Archipelago, configure production flows, refine resources, and achieve perfect efficiency.

games.name: KARAKARA3
games.summary: "Let us live on this land so arid." Leon's peaceful days suddenly come to an end when he hears the sound of a telephone, a Relic from the past and is informed that Cullen, a member of the town vigilante corp, is being held hostage. The final chapter in the KARAKARA series.

games.name: Mantle (2026)
games.summary: Mantle is a multiplayer creation platform built on Unreal Engine 5. Publish playable worlds in seconds, then join instantly through one client with no per-place download. Explore worlds made by other creators, team up with friends, and build your own using the in-editor tools.

games.name: Midnight Love Diner
games.summary: Run a late-night cafe in Tokyo, serve meals tailored to your regulars, and investigate the secrets behind their requests. Balance supplies, cooking and income with clues, conversations and relationships in this 2D single-player narrative adventure and management game.

games.name: My Little Shadow
games.summary: A little daughter, right on your desktop. Choose a child to share your days with: she plays, draws you gifts, gets a little mischievous, and naps nearby while you work. Share snacks, play together, and grow closer at your own pace—without daily chores or guilt for being away.

games.name: NEONOVA Puzzle: Red
games.summary: NEONOVA Puzzle: Red is an atmospheric jigsaw puzzle game that combines anime aesthetics with Christmas-inspired neon cyberpunk. Assemble futuristic images, connect the pieces, and unlock vibrant illustrations filled with glowing neon, festive decorations, mysterious characters and technologies.

games.name: Nightclub Security
games.summary: In this absurd first-person bouncer game, you have 10 seconds to decide who gets into the club. Check IDs, catch drunks and hidden contraband, confiscate forbidden items, then let them in - or slap, shove, grab, and throw them out.

games.name: Nik and Kit
games.summary: Albertino - a friendly physicist has some lessons for you. No matter how good you are at school you can now take few more lessons and try this awesome puzzle game with a beautiful cartoony graphics and stunning gameplay. The goal of each level is to connect light emitters with corresponding receptors – sounds easy, eh? You might want to try it yourself!Features:•80 challenging levels (more to come!)•Stunning 2D cartoon graphics & animation•Original music by Justin Sandercoe!•Highly polished gameplay•Game Center enabled•Achievements•Online leaderboards•In-game tutorial

games.name: Orby vs Rects
games.summary: Break the Rects. Collect Recties. Upgrade. Repeat. Orby vs Rects is a retro-inspired shooter that captures the spirit of Arkanoid and Tetris classics, while delivering modern fast-paced bullet-hell action.

games.name: PC Store Together
games.summary: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.

games.name: Pheles Rebirth
games.summary: Pheles Rebirth is an RPG where you play as Pheles, a fallen angel who rebelled against God, and lead two knights into battle. Make their choices for them and turn the tide with over 250 skills and abilities in total, plus Unleashed Thoughts, powerful effects triggered by conditions in combat.

games.name: Raiding Season
games.summary: Lead a band of Viking raiders in search of wealth and glory in this turn-based tactical RPG. Recruit warriors, customize their abilities, and battle across deadly hex-based maps. Burn, plunder, and press onward for greater riches but rising enemy resistance could cost you everything you’ve gained.

games.name: Single File
games.summary: A pixel-art auto-battler. An old master and his three students march down the road in single file and fight on their own. The one in front takes the blows, and the fallen walk to the back. You tap the spells, and Spirit doesn't refill by itself. Win or lose, the gold grows the dojo's skill tree.

games.name: Star Purr
games.summary: One cat. Too much catnip. A galaxy of mice between it and its own mind. Star Purr is a psychedelic roguelite shooter: build outrageous weapons, beat bosses born from the psyche, chase the SSS combo.

games.name: Stranding Echoes
games.summary: STRANDING ECHOES is a minimalist colony sim. Manage the non-corporeal creatures called echo to build your base and survive the heat.

games.name: Supinaa: Rogue Sapling
games.summary: You are reborn as sapling and hear voices that that guide your every steps.Fight, explore and power up to survive in this hostile world. You have free will but are the choices always yours?

games.name: Tell Me How I Can Hurt You
games.summary: A psychological visual novel about a girl who’s in love with a teddy bear who’s in love with her. And a secret they both share.

games.name: Terminus: Day Zero
games.summary: Terminus: Day Zero is a free, short zombie survival adventure set in the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors. On the first day of the outbreak, Daisy is home alone, and the dead are getting closer. Hide, shut the doors, and run.

games.name: The Spotter: Dig or Die
games.summary: Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

games.name: Tidy Up Christmas Shop
games.summary: 5,434 Christmas items are scattered across the shop. Put them back where they belong and enjoy the wonderful order. No timer, no stress. Upgrade your skills with the candy you earn and arrange colourful, twinkling Christmas items on the shelves of a huge two-storey shop as you like. Merry Christmas!

games.name: TOO MANY CLANKERS
games.summary: Incremental tower defense game about one simple problem: TOO MANY CLANKERS. Build an absurd amount of firepower and reduce the CLANKERS to scrap.

games.name: Totally Not Gaming
games.summary: In Totally Not Gaming, we offer classic mini-games like Spider Solitaire, FreeCell, Klondike Solitaire, and Minesweeper—all disguised as office software! Come join us for some fun slacking off at work!

games.name: Ueru
games.summary: The mornings in your new Japanese home are so peaceful that it’s easy to dismiss the nights as all in your mind. Explore the house, learn the language, and figure out what hungers in the dark in this atmospheric point-and-click interactive fiction game.

games.name: Unbury the Gamer Girl
games.summary: A short, oddball first-person cleanup game about unburying a lonely gamer girl from her own garbage. Throw out trash, upgrade your suction gun, and poke around her room while she talks, complains, and slowly lets her guard down. Crude humor, strange things to find, and someone to hang out with.

games.name: Undervein
games.summary: A pixel-art idle miner. Click the seam, hire ten producers, spend Ancient Ore on gadgets and Cursed Ore on a 50-rune technology tree, then reset for a permanent bonus - fifty times. Minigames behind the ancient door, 1,500 metres of depth.

games.name: Very Very RARE
games.summary: Forge insanely rare turrets in an incremental idle tower defense. Hunt impossible loot, unlock powerful relics, expand your skill tree, complete quests, and discover game-breaking synergies as you chase the rarest drops imaginable.

games.name: Witchkeeping
games.summary: Everything was clean at ten. Now the books are on the floor, potion is running down the wall, and there are muddy footprints on the stairs. Hop on your broom and put the witch's tower back in order, one shelf at a time. And keep an eye on that cat. Nothing sorts itself.

games.name: Wizard of Maths
games.summary: Conquer your maths anxiety and build numerical confidence through fun and challenging quests! Wizard of Maths is a JRPG-inspired, research-backed arithmetic adventure that helps you unlock your inner “human calculator,” whether you’re a child learning the basics or an adult sharpening your skills.

games.name: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic - Space Program
Anvilia
games.summary: Run a medieval blacksmith shop in co-op. Gather resources, forge tools, stock your shelves, and grow a thriving business.

games.name: Bad Grip Club
games.summary: Bad Grip Club is a physics-based co-op climbing game for VR with crossplay. Climb a cartoonish mountain where physical grip and teamwork are your only hope. Pull your friends up, use quirky items, and survive diverse biomes. Can your squad reach the top without falling down together?

games.name: BitLoaf
games.summary: BitLoaf turns your Windows desktop into a living, interactive 3D world. Expressive bread characters wander, snack, socialize, and play on their own while you work, or step in anytime to toss props around, arrange their space, and kick off games.

games.name: Bone Bazaar
games.summary: This is a Sword And Sandals inspired Turn-based arena RPG. Play a skeleton gladiator in the Greek underworld: pick one action per round, shatter enemy armor, forge and enchant weapons, cheer up a crowd of ghosts. Beat 4 arenas and 4 bosses to face Hades, who swore the winner goes free.

games.name: BORE
games.summary: Crew THE MULE, a colossal drilling machine, with up to three friends and descend into the whispering earth. Man the instruments, sortie into the dark for the specimens the Bureau wants, and shut the door before what heard you gets inside. Sell. Descend deeper. Try to come back up.

games.name: Bungle Brawl: Couch Co-op Party
games.summary:
Grab your friends. Lift them over your head. Throw them off a pizza rooftop.
Bungle Brawl is a wobbly physics party brawler for 1–4 players on one screen, with bots to fill every match.

Everyone is the same jelly body in a different costume. Be a Banana, a Shark, a Hot Dog, a Ghost or a Nightstand. Punch, kick and grab. Knock a fighter dizzy, carry them to the edge while the crowd chants, and let go.

11 MAPS, 11 WAYS TO FALL
• Rooftop: "Don't look down. Also, it smells like pizza."
• Wrestling Ring: the floor is bouncy, the folding chairs are not.
• Space Station: zero gravity, and the airlock opens every 20–30 seconds.
• Luxury Cruise: five-star accommodation on a tiny wooden raft.
• Airplane: fight on the wings. It gets windy.
• Plus Broken Bridge, Camp, Construction Site, Cliff and two football pitches.

STUFF DROPS FROM THE SKY
Frying pans. Air horns that make everyone in front of you dizzy. A leaf blower. A bee hive thrower. A jetpack. A bomb nobody wants to hold. Homing rockets. 18 items drop at random, so every round goes a bit differently.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Last Man Standing: knock everyone out or off the map. The last one standing takes the round. First to 4, 6 or 8 wins.
• Football: yellow vs blue soccer, with ragdolls. Every goal gets slow motion, confetti and a roaring crowd.
• Randomized: every map from both modes in a shuffled order.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• 1–4 players on one screen, plus up to 4 bots, for up to 8 fighters.
• Playing alone? Take on the bots.
• Charge a power punch, land a homing flying kick, then taunt with 13 emotes like "EASY!" and "OOPS!"
• Turn on Slow Motion for the whole match.

COMFORT SETTINGS
Screen shake slider, a toggle for comic hit words, Reduce Flashing, six volume sliders and controller vibration controls.

11 achievements, including Pizza Delivery Failed and Wrong Net, Champion.

Bungle Brawl is a local multiplayer game played on one screen. It has no online multiplayer.

games.name: Bush League Baseball
games.summary:
Arcade baseball with real rules and terrible players, in full 3D: bobblehead ballplayers, eight ballparks and Chuck Baseball, a booth announcer who loves every error. 

Found your own club, build its ballpark, and trade club codes with friends. One or two players.

games.name: Card Dice
games.summary: An idle progression game with a casino dice theme. Let your card dice roll automatically and beat opponents in timed matches. Collect gems and engravings to create different builds, trade up your equipment, and advance to higher-level tables.

games.name: Chalk Thrower Simulator
games.summary: Keep a sleepy class awake by throwing chalk then a duster to finish. Draft perks between periods, climb twelve Standards, outlast Detention, race the Daily or crack 32 chalk puzzles. Solo, online co-op or versus.

games.name: Chess Lords
games.summary: A cinematic medieval chess saga! Take on 12 rivals in the Campaign, play Free Battle, solve 24 checkmate puzzles and watch every capture become a brutal, piece-specific execution.

games.name: Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story - Room & Cozy Activities Expansion
Chinese Landmine Girl: Lan Qiao Afterstory - Winter and Summer of Flowers and Cicadas
Chinese Pancake Simulator
games.summary: Start with a humble pancake stand, purchase ingredients, cook pancakes, serve customers, and upgrade your equipment as you grow your business day by day.

games.name: Chinese-Style Exams
games.summary: How would you score today? Chinese-Style Exams is a nostalgic single-player exam simulator. Work your way from Grade 1 to Grade 12 through Chinese, math, and English exams, review your scores and feedback, and try again as you work toward China's high school and university entrance exams.

games.name: Cities: Skylines - Content Creator Pack: Holiday Getaways
Cities: Skylines - Content Creator Pack: Mansions & Manors
Click Cafe
games.summary: An active incremental where you've inherited a struggling cafe...along with a huge debt. Wait on tables and serve food as orders keep coming in. Purchase upgrades to expand your cafe, make more money, and pay off your debt!

games.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens
Corefall: Idle Dungeon RPG
games.summary: Assemble a party of heroes, descend into a living 3D dungeon, and watch them fight. A deep idle RPG with TONS of ENDLESS Content!

games.name: Critter Rumble
games.summary: Build your team of monsters, choose which enemies to fight, recruit the ones you defeat, and evolve your team in a roguelite autobattler with permanent buffs. Adapt your strategy and face increasingly powerful Bosses!

games.name: Dead Last (Eddie Eizner)
games.summary: A first-person horror party game for 2–8 friends. The dealer runs a night of short, scary minigames, and the further behind you fall, the better the items she deals you. Shove your friends into danger, steal their lead, and survive the night.

games.name: Eleven FC Manager
games.summary: The most old-school football manager you'll find. Start in the 10th division, build your squad, pick your XI, adjust at half-time and climb to the top flight: 200 clubs, 10 divisions, 7,000+ players. No microtransactions, no loot boxes. Play solo or with up to 3 managers on one PC.

games.name: Ezalm : Magic's Memory
games.summary: A narrative-driven action RPG where your combat style depends on the elemental magic you choose. Lost in a forgotten region, unravel the mysteries of ancient peoples to find your way back to Ezalm.

games.name: Fantasy Immortal Sect
games.summary: 水墨修仙回合制RPG。你接手一座落魄宗门，于苍梧群山之间招徒纳贤、营建洞天楼阁、开炉炼丹、锻造奇兵、收服培养本命灵兽。前往聚宝当铺与诸派客商互通有无，探索随机生成的大千世界，每局地貌、机缘、敌宗皆不相同。抵御外敌来袭，应对机缘事件，从凡人步步登仙。在东方山水绘卷里慢节奏经营宗门，以策略回合战斗决胜，体验国风水墨的清冷淡雅。这是你亲手写就的修仙长卷。

games.name: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop
For Bumble's Sake
games.summary: You are Brumhilde von Hummelbommel. You wake up alone in February: find a hole in the ground, gather pollen and nectar, raise your daughters and build your nest. Nine months against wasps, birds, storms and heat. In November only one thing counts: is your colony still standing?

games.name: Fruit Store Simulator
games.summary: Stock it, price it, sell it, and turn a small corner fruit shop into the neighborhood's favorite fruit store.

games.name: GOD OF DEFIANCE
games.summary: Heaven wants you pure; the demonesses have other plans—build a deadly deck, chase a monster mahjong hand, and ask the gods one question: since when is your love life any of their damn business?

games.name: Gothic 3
games.summary: You have saved the island Khorinis from the forces of evil in Gothic I and Gothic II. Now it is time to travel to the realms of the mainland. Invading Orcs have enslaved the human kingdom. There are but a few free humans in the icy north and the southern desert and a handful of rebels hiding in the forests and mountains of Midland. You may either join the rebellion or serve the Orcish Usurpers but you will ultimately tip the scales and decide the outcome of the last war to save humanity. There is no simple linear story in Gothic III - every game will be different and unique - but all will ultimately lead to you deciding the fate of Myrtana.

games.name: Gotta Catch Bugs!
games.summary: Gotta Catch Bugs! is a cozy first-person bug-catching game. A mutant plant has overgrown an underground lab and broken the control panel - 5,000 mutant insects are on the loose. Catch them with a net and jar, return all 500 species to their terrariums and unlock their powers!

games.name: Haunted! But Sorted.
games.summary: Stock shelves with your friends and survive the night shift in this atmospheric co-op horror game. Sort products, share the workload, and keep an eye on the darkness behind you. Apparently, being terrified isn't a good enough reason to clock out.

games.name: HelloLove2:Binary
games.summary: 2030: AI companions reshape romance. As an emotion engineer with missing memories, you awaken in a tangled love affair. A commanding boss, an awakened AI, an anti-AI rebel, and a mysterious system enter your life. Each choice rewrites fate. Is algorithmic love still love?

games.name: Hounded Reborn Greyhound Racing
games.summary: Hounded Reborn Greyhound Racing creates a fantasy world of greyhound racing. Buy, name and enjoy your own record breaking champion. Select between pups to buy, trainers, and optionally gamble away your fortune. Achieve cup wins, track records and top the asset value list.

games.name: I'd Choose the Bear
games.summary: Thirty days to save your late Nana's cottage in Honeywood, a lakeside town where bears and people live side by side. Date six very different bears (one of them is technically a human), outwit a resort developer, and decide who you'd really rather meet in the woods.

games.name: Incremental Pachinko Heaven
games.summary: Launch balls! Upgrade the board! Rake in mountains of medals and pay off debt after debt! A focused pachinko incremental game you can finish in 4–6 hours.

games.name: Iron Maw
games.summary: Command the Iron Maw, an armored war train, against the Meridian Iron & Ordnance Company's Legions. Build a devastating convoy, crush colossal war machines, and defend the ten free cities that refuse to kneel.

games.name: Jester's Dungeon
games.summary: An Obscure Dungeon Crawler where you a wizard, Dives into a dungeon to reclaim your stolen Toy from a wicked Jester.  Sacrifice your blood to the Black Eye and  use it's powers to survive, slay monsters and master the dungeon .

games.name: Kabakura
games.summary: Kyabakura Wars is a kyabakura management sim with a visual novel inside. Take a club drowning in debt, turn it into the best venue in town, and defeat the four rival bosses standing between you and fame.

games.name: Kingdomsweeper
games.summary: A kingdom-building minesweeper. Defeat monsters, free ruins and restore each part of the kingdom to its former glory in a logic based adventure where each map and puzzle brings new challenges and strategic choices.

games.name: Last Order
games.summary: A narrative adventure set in a quiet bar in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo. Choose a cocktail, listen to stories of life, and leave each night with a poem—all presented through a distinctive visual style inspired by traditional Japanese manga and gekiga.

games.name: Matryoshka
games.summary: Cursed entities that devour humans have gotten into the Matryoshka dolls. Inspect them with extreme caution. If you encounter a cursed doll, you must immediately burn and seal it away. A single mistake will be fatal.

games.name: Mayhem Duck Simulator
games.summary: Are you ready to explore the freedom of being a rubber duck? ???? Mayhem Duck Simulator is a relaxing yet chaotic plastic duck simulator. Take control of every duck, rescue special friends, and stir up trouble! Whether you seek peace or pure madness, the entire pool is yours to command! ✨????????

games.name: Metromino
games.summary: Build your own metropolis from tetromino pieces! Start with a small village, grow your city, build roads and upgrades, earn millions, and keep your residents happy.

games.name: Moon Base: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Thousands of things are dumped in one giant pile at a Moon base. Climb it, bound across the cargo yard in low gravity and put every last item back where it belongs, on your own or with up to three friends, in this cosy co-op tidy-up game.

games.name: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness
My Child New Beginnings
games.summary:
A new chance, a new school, and a new village. It's time for a new beginning with you and your child.

When things go badly for you and your adoptive child, Karin or Klaus, two years ago, you both move to a tiny apartment in a new village where you meet friendlier neighbors and try to start a new life. Life was challenging but you had each other, as you both moved on from the trauma you encountered. Now you have the opportunity to move into a proper home and Karin begins in a new school, but not everything is as it seems as your child is holding back about their past and its up to you to discover what it means to heal together.

This new emotional successor, inspired from the BAFTA award-winning, My Child Lebensborn, places you and your child in a new timeline and in a new setting where you both learn to heal in a life after trauma. You’ll discover why some bad memories don’t go away and encounter new challenges as Karin or Klaus deals with intense trauma responses brought on by the past.

games.name: Nine Lives Below
games.summary: Descend with 1-4 wizard cats through every-pixel-simulated caverns! Craft chaotic modular wands, swat volatile potions off shelves, trigger chain-reaction falling-sand alchemy, and share one pool of 9 Lives in online co-op or solo roguelike runs.

games.name: No Asteroids
games.summary: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, sell the ore, and buy guns for your ship that fire while you dig.

games.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
games.summary: A boy, a flashlight, and a house that no longer feels like home. No Such Monsters is a side-scrolling horror adventure. Explore dark rooms, tunnels, and a ruined chapel, solve environmental puzzles, and outrun the creatures that find you.

games.name: One More Donut
games.summary: Transform a delicious mountain of 2,500+ donuts into ultimate visual perfection! Sort tasty treats, buy upgrades, and unwind to a cozy Lo-Fi soundtrack in this satisfying tidying simulator.

games.name: OutGraft
games.summary: A colossal, grotesque monster never stops chasing you in this fast-paced 2D horror action runner. Slash or leap past enemies, equip different back-mounted parasites each run, and land hits to charge Overheat—then surge forward and trigger their automatic abilities at once before it catches you.

games.name: Poker Night Live
games.summary: Real No-Limit Texas Hold’em with your friends — live webcam and voice chat right at the table. Seat up to 7 friends online, or play solo against Easy, Medium and Hard bots anytime.

games.name: Seoul Zombie City
games.summary: The world has fallen to zombies. Flee east. To Gangnam. Don't worry if you die—this is a roguelite. Explore shifting maps across time loops, manage your inventory, bond with companions, and uncover the truth. You can reach all 5 endings and the True Ending in 3–4 hours.

games.name: Shanhai Phantasm
games.summary: 《山海幻境》是首款以像素画风探索山海神话的三消即时战斗+卡牌RPG游戏！ 每天点一点，上班摸鱼下班放空；指尖消一消，即时战斗激爽三消！ 山海游一游，游历八荒共斗异兽；BOSS打一打，每周8张自选英雄！ 所有养成资源均有免费产出途径，不花钱的研究型玩家也能爽玩； 氪金玩家可以通过付费，提升养成速度，获得快速养成的快感！

games.name: SHRED A BILLION
games.summary: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to go!

games.name: Sinkhole Chaser
games.summary: A scientific expedition team composed of Chinese and foreign researchers fell into a sinkhole due to an accident, and the entire team mysteriously lost contact. As the captain of the emergency search and rescue mission, you will overcome numerous obstacles and confront the unknown fate head-on

games.name: SquareFrontlineTD
games.summary: This is a classic and visually refreshing 3D floating block map tower defense game. While protecting the base, enjoy the thrill of strategic deployment and repelling groups of enemies, which is perfect for casual players and tower defense enthusiasts.

games.name: Starward Protocol
games.summary: Launch, collect, upgrade! Starward Protocol is an incremental rocket shooter. Build your firepower, expand your upgrade tree, dodge dense bullet patterns, and defeat mechanical bosses on your journey to the stars.

games.name: Starwinder
games.summary: A vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up. Each run takes you through 7 of 14 worlds, every stage ends with a mini boss with its own signature move, and a multi-part final boss waits at the end. Local co-op, Remote Play Together, Daily Challenge and Boss Rush.

games.name: Storage Hunter Simulator
games.summary:
Step up to the challenge and take a risk in the world of Storage Hunter Simulator, where you'll compete against others for the ultimate prize - garages filled with hidden treasures waiting to be discovered! In this exciting game, you'll have the chance to showcase your skills and become a giant of the storage market!

In this simulation game, you'll need to master the art of auctions, selling valuable items to wealthy collectors, and improving your skills as an appraiser to stay ahead of the competition. But that's just the beginning - the storage empire is waiting for you!

games.name: Sun Knight and the Evil Trial
games.summary: A single-player action RPG blending pixel art with 3D environments. Explore varied lands, master stamina-based combat, and face altar bosses and twelve demon lords. Forge your build, hatch pet companions, and rest by the campfire on a journey through loss and memory.

games.name: Swift Cultivation
games.summary: Swift Cultivation is a text-based idle cultivation game. Queue up your work and let time do the rest: breakthroughs happen on their own, and every death sends you back stronger.

games.name: Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga - Hold the Line
The drawing of the Exodus
games.summary: This is a summary of the Book of Exodus from the Bible, told using images generated by artificial intelligence and accompanied by brief captions.

games.name: The Lawbreakers Club
games.summary: It's 2007. It's lunchtime. You've got half an hour, a desktop full of games, and a whole crew to meet. Come hang out!

games.name: The Temple
games.summary: In the far future, explore an abandoned planet aboard three distinct vehicles. Drive deep beneath the sea, glide high amongst the clouds, and fly even higher in orbit. Immerse in the atmosphere, avoid eldritch dangers and figure out what happened in this two hours long cosmic horror adventure.

games.name: Tool Tidy
games.summary: A cosy, first person, tidying game set in a wrecked mechanic's shop. Put every tool, tub, bottle, can and part back where it belongs before opening time, and before Uncle Vic gets back!

games.name: Trash Inc.
games.summary: Turn a bankrupt recycling yard into a smooth-running operation in this relaxing incremental management game. Open bags and sort waste by hand, hire a crew, install processing machines, and automate the journey from truck delivery to valuable recycled goods.

games.name: Wreck the Deck
games.summary: Take control of a powerful pirate cannon and turn everything on deck into flying debris! Shoot cannonballs, destroy objects, trigger devastating shockwaves, and collect cash to unlock powerful upgrades. The more you wreck, the stronger your cannon becomes.

games.name: Zero Mass
games.summary: Carve through asteroids, haul valuable ore, and upgrade your mining ship in ZERO MASS, a single player space mining game. Take on contracts, deploy drones and drilling rigs, uncover buried artifacts, and tackle dangerous encounters across procedural asteroid fields.

games.name: ZERO MASS: Custom Colours Supporter Pack
Beryl
games.summary: Team up with up to three friends in a free-to-play action RPG. Build your hero from 720 skills, find rare gear, socket gems into your gear, and fight through 840 kinds of monsters and 14 colossal bosses on ever-harder world difficulties.

games.name: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss
Clip Out: Backrooms
games.summary: Play solo or in 2-player online co-op in this PSX style extraction roguelite based on the Backrooms. Explore procedural levels, scavenge for loot, and extract alive to upgrade your gear.

games.name: Clocks Sleep at Zero
games.summary: Are you a pop culture fanatic... and do you like fun and addictive puzzle games?!?! Play Puzzle Dash Pro: Celebrity Edition and have an absolute blast! Highlights:* Ad Free Version* Start with more hints and time boosts than the free version* Finish a puzzle in 60 seconds to advance to next level! * 5 Puzzle Worlds with 60 Levels in total * Collect stars to unlock categories, earn hints, and hit high scores * Need some help? Use time boosts to play a bit longer!

games.name: Coins in Place
games.summary: Coins in Place is an incremental game where you work as a coin picker in a messy tavern. Pick up every coin before the day ends! Earn gems, buy upgrades, and recruit cats to help you. On Day 7, a mountain of coins awaits. Miss even one and you're stuck working another week.

games.name: Coma Dreams
games.summary: Guide a wounded Marine through a nightmare born of his own coma, facing the horrors of war, scarce ammunition, puzzles, and dark labyrinths. Evade a colossal, relentless pursuer, overcome manifestations of his deepest psychological traumas at every stage, and help him wake up and return to reality.

games.name: Cucumber
games.summary:
Cucumber is a jumping Cucumber Simulation Game, in which you will jump with your cucumber!

The Goal of the Game is to reach the highest possible jumping score with your cucumber.

Get a random cucumber every 3 hours and grow your fantastic cucumber collection!

games.name: Cursed Words: The Madness Of Michael
DualBeats
games.summary: Notes flow in from both sides toward the center. Play solo with both hands, or team up with a friend on one screen. You never have to chase the notes themselves, so you can focus purely on the music. Build charts for your own songs with the built-in editor and share them easily as QR images.

games.name: Hadean Tactics
games.summary: Hadean Tactics is a roguelike deckbuilding game fused with autobattler elements to create a unique strategy experience. Use your cards to influence the actions of your units and help your Hero defeat the Six Wings of Hell!

games.name: Hop 'n' Karty
games.summary: Hop and Marty are back in an all new Kart Racing game from Evilkookey games. Play as all your favourite characters from the Hop 'n' Marty and battle it out as you blast through the courses on your way to first place. Play alone or with friends and try to beat your best times.

games.name: Incremental Pain Profit
games.summary: Click, topple and profit! Knock over tiny wandering Humans, hire Animals to cause chaos, collect mountains of coins and grow your ridiculous empire. Unlock powerful Rebirth upgrades, defeat Bosses and turn a peaceful board into a glorious mess of falling people.

games.name: Meme Paint
games.summary: Meme Paint is a unique take on the well-known Paint

games.name: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon
Necro Rising
games.summary: Play as a necromancer: harvest souls from corpses, raise an army, and trade your power for the resurrection of humanity.

games.name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators
Nothing Goes Right: Bad Business Demo
Piece by Piece
games.summary:
It's time to open shop! 

Inherit your family's repair shop, and roll up your sleeves. Fix up the prized possessions of the forest folk, paint yourself a masterpiece to sell and make your family shop all your own with decorations, furniture and cookies!

Customize your shop with different colours and materials, grow plants and mix paint, spruce up the items that pass through the store, bake cookies for your neighbours, and listen to the latest gossip - are you ready to roll up your sleeves and open up shop?

games.name: Pocket Dynasty
games.summary: Super Lotto Scratch Off - Lottery Scratchers is a fun game where you can win millions. Test your luck with our scratcher tickets and scratch cards modeled after California's most popular scratchers. Seven scratcher cards included, with many more added frequently.Experience the most realistic scratcher game for iOS!!! Are you addicted to real scratch off lottery tickets? Scratch away your hearts content without shelling out real money.Features-Advanced scratcher effects and graphics.-Daily credits and payoffs.-Win coins and money to earn your spot on the leader boards and unlock new scratcher cards.-Smart scratch detection, knows exactly when your done scratching.-New Scratcher tickets added frequently.-Scratcher Ticket created by @RickyMetzIf you like playing games like Bingo, Slot Machines, Card Games, Scratcher Games, Board, Poker, Gambling and Betting Games, you'll love Super Lotto Scratchers.*Disclaimer: You cannot win real money while playing this game yet.....

games.name: Shelfish
games.summary: Undo anything. Nothing locks. A cozy organizing puzzle where every drag snaps into place, a ghost shows exactly where each thing will land, and any mistake is one press from fixed. Tidy 40 levels across five rooms with Shelly the hermit crab, plus a fresh drawer every day.

games.name: Slimy Dude
games.summary: Slimy Dude is a hand-drawn action-adventure where you play as a soldier, running from kingdom to kingdom against forces greater simply to escape his past. You will meet new allies, become stronger, uncover secrets and explore new environments.

games.name: Son of Beach
games.summary: Start as a Beach Caretaker Intern. Clean up trash left behind by tourists and recycle it to unlock powerful new tools. Follow the changing tides to dig up hidden treasures beneath the sand. Catch seafood, run your own seafood stand, and sell rare coastal collectibles in your treasure shop.

games.name: Sort of Cheesy: Tidy up the Cheese Cave
Sort On The Ball
games.summary: A cozy game about opening tons of capsules to sort and collect cute toy balls. Sort like you're on the ball!

games.name: SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit
Sunstone of Time
games.summary:
Step into the role of a brilliant young scientist whose fascination with ancient relics leads to an unexpected journey through history. Sunstone of Time is a historical VR odyssey where exploration, secret discovery, and intricate puzzle-solving are your keys to survival in the vibrant world of the Aztecs, and your only hope of returning home!

After a groundbreaking experiment goes awry, you awaken in a distant past, thrust into an unfamiliar era. Explore breathtaking temples, ancient settlements, and sacred sites. Piece together forgotten knowledge, interact with a vibrant world, and meet unique characters, each with their own stories and motives. But danger lurks in the shadows: a powerful high priest is weaving dark schemes that threaten not only your fate, but the future of the entire world. Only your intelligence, courage, and insatiable curiosity can guide you through this ancient labyrinth of challenges.

Unravel a rich and engaging story as every step brings you closer to understanding Aztec culture and uncovering the path back to your own time. Will you rise to the challenge, reshape your destiny, and save the world?

games.name: Take This Thing Out Of Me
Tea ceremony simulator
games.summary: A quiet tearoom, but chaos in your hands! A first-person tea ceremony simulator where you brew matcha yourself—holding, tilting, and spilling. Nothing is automated, so mistakes get served as is. Score 80+ three times in a row to face a special guest. Can you score a perfect 100?

games.name: The Last Embrace: Book One - Official Walkthrough
The Sixth Sin
games.summary: A great upheaval is coming to the wonderful, magical world of Londerol. The hour draws near when the prophecy will be fulfilled and legions of darkness will pour forth into this bright world.But the gracious gods give humanity a final chance. Heroes emerge from among the people, ready to fearlessly defend what is good and just. Magister of Magic Farian and his student Alex set out on a long and dangerous journey to gain knowledge, power and, of course, new friends.You have the unique opportunity to become Farian's student and make your contribution to the history of the kingdom of Londerol. Defend the shores of Londerol against pirates, uncover the barons' conspiracy and save the charming Princess Ellacrielle. Battle with bloodthirsty clans of orcs and procure the gold of the dwarves! On great mountain peaks, in deep caves and in scorching hot deserts, discover ancient spells to use in the great battle with the legions of the demon Rikhdash.Travel the difficult path from student to Grand Mage, learning all of the spells to summon towers and magic! Turn demons to dust and win the love of a princess! Try your powers in the testing grounds in Survival Mode and become a record holder in the Academy of Mages! Fight desperately, boldly and decisively! Discover all of the chapters in the chronicles of Londerol! Go down in history as a great mage, hero!FEATURES- An exciting story about the glorious kingdom of Londerol, with amazing landscapes and an excellent TD experience!- Two game modes: CAMPAIGN with three levels of difficulty and SURVIVAL.- CAMPAIGN: 14 perfectly balanced levels of fierce battles with crowds of invaders, which challenge you to devise cunning tactics and strategies.- SURVIVAL: 4 unique maps on which you must only try to survive while being attacked by countless hordes of ruthless enemies.- 8 types of magical towers, each with 5 unique upgrade stages.- 2 super towers: a Dwarven Tower and a Hell Tower.- 5 types of elemental spells, each with 5 unique upgrade stages.- Over 25 types of land and air enemies (Orcs, demons, monsters, machines etc.).- An option to reset spell upgrades to embark on a new strategy.- Fantastic music and sound effects.- Global leaderboards (Game Center support) and a creative approach to an achievements system.- Support for multiple languages.

games.name: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot
Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero
Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix
Big Golden Rock
games.summary: Big Golden Rock is a pixel incremental clicker about a huge golden rock. Gather resources, hire shooters and archers, build towers, launch rockets, summon UFOs, and unlock increasingly powerful upgrades.

games.name: Cascade
games.summary: Paint spells. Break the cascade. Build four hand-crafted spells, survive an escalating action roguelite campaign, then push its Rift Depth 1-99 endgame.

games.name: Cheerleaders Boys: Naughty School Spirit
games.summary:
A squad of guys cheering only for you. Play their games, earn their attention and unlock exclusive images!

On this campus, the loudest guys in the stadium aren’t on the field. They’re the cheer squad, and from the first practice they can’t stop looking your way.

Jump into a run of minigames: quick quiz rounds, reflex tests, timing challenges and more. The boys shout your name when you nail it and laugh with you when you don’t. Every win moves the story forward and opens a new image in your gallery.

There’s the confident captain who flirts like it’s part of the routine, the quiet flyer who only opens up after practice, and the rival who pretends he isn’t keeping score. Each one has something to show you, if you stick around long enough.

How far will you go to become the one they’re really cheering for?

games.name: Cheerleaders Girls: Naughty School Spirit
games.summary:
The squad needs someone to cheer for, and they picked you. Win their games and unlock exclusive images!

Game day is coming and the campus cheer squad is missing one thing: someone who can keep up with them. Head to the field, the locker room and the bleachers, where every routine is a chance to get a little closer.

Take on a mix of minigames, from rapid-fire quiz rounds to reflex and timing challenges, while the girls cheer you on, tease you when you slip and celebrate every win. Clear them to push the story forward and unlock new images for your gallery.

The bubbly captain, the shy new girl, the rival who swears she isn’t impressed. Each one has her own vibe and her own way of showing she likes you.

So, can you keep up with the squad, or will they leave you on the bench?

games.name: Derby Heroines: Race to the Finish!
games.summary:
Don't just watch the race — run it! Control your heroine directly in high-speed derby-style racing action.

Derby Heroines: Race to the Finish! is a racing action game where you don't watch from the stands — you're in the race, controlling one of the heroines yourself.

■ You're the one running
You control the heroine herself as she tears down the track. Fight for position in the pack, and choose the perfect moment to burn your dash gauge — it never recharges, so timing is everything. Grab orbs on the track to trigger skills, use items to slow your rivals or boost yourself, and save your special move — one use per race — for the moment that decides it all.
Each heroine has her own running style, from front-runners who set the pace to closers who bet everything on the final stretch. Find the style that fits her, and make it count.

■ 55 races to conquer
Five stages, 55 races in all. Finish in the top 3 to move on. Rivals get tougher with every stage, while field sizes and race distances keep changing. Combine 15 skills and 12 special moves to build your own way to win.

games.name: Egypt Farm
games.summary:
Experience farming in Ancient Egypt! Raise animals, grow crops, manage your resources, and build a thriving farm in the heart of Egypt!

Choose between a male or female character and experience everyday life in the countryside. Plant and harvest a variety of vegetables, feed and raise animals, and sell your produce and livestock to earn money and expand your farm.

Gather valuable resources to develop your property. Hire workers to help collect wood, stone, and gold, allowing you to manage your time more efficiently and boost productivity.

Buy food to keep your animals well-fed, and don't forget to take care of yourself! Purchase food to restore your energy or head home for a good night's sleep to regain your strength.

Build your farm, manage your resources, and transform a small piece of Ancient Egypt into a prosperous farming empire.

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary:
A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. 

This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: Fortune Avenue
games.summary: A competitive board game where players vote to shape their destiny. Transform caravans into 5-star hotels, collect wonders, and earn bounties for bankrupting opponents. Use airports to outmaneuver rivals, organize World Cups to multiply your rent. Can you turn your empire into a global monopoly?

games.name: Full Metal Sergeant 2
games.summary: Manage your camp, drill soldiers into specialized war machines and dominate turn-based battles. 12 Weeks. 9 Recruits. 1 Rule: break them or lose them.

games.name: Gravity Switch
games.summary: Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks!

games.name: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price
Japan Bus Simulator
games.summary:
"Japan Bus Simulator" is a simulation game that combines driving a route bus with managing a bus company. The setting is a fictional town reminiscent of a Japanese city. 

Start with a small office and one bus and grow your bus company to run throughout the town.

games.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
games.summary:
You’ve just inherited your grandma’s once-famous meatball restaurant in the cozy town of KuloNiku. Now it’s up to you to bring it back to glory as the top eatery! Take on eccentric orders from townsfolk, serve delicious meals, and restore your family’s legacy.

Beware - there’s fierce competition from the town’s flashiest rival: Souper Starz, run by the menacing rockstar chef, Stella!

Prep your stations for a cozy cooking game with attitude! Prepare unique meals for quirky small-town locals, upgrade and customize your shop, compete in thrilling cooking battles to become top chef, and protect your family’s long-running restaurant alongside a cast of curious companions!

games.name: Machine Party
games.summary:
Welcome to Machine Party. In this series of dangerous, and some would say highly illegal, party games you will have to use every trick in the book to survive. 

Play through classic party game formats and new twists on the genre for sessions of fun, screaming, and horror.

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Mawkey The Last Macaw
games.summary:
Mawkey The Last Macaw is a 2D pixel art adventure in which we control Mawkey, trying to prevent the destruction of the environment and the mistreatment of animals in Honduras.

Step into Mawkey's shoes and explore the linear world of Honduras, freeing animals and stopping the deforestation of evil businessman Adreim.

games.name: ONE-ROOM ZOMBIE
games.summary:
A survival action game where you battle swarms of zombies in the confined space of a single room.

Attacks are automatic, keeping controls simple - just move and change direction.

Level up and select new weapons from treasure chests to expand your arsenal. Create the ultimate build and survive!

Use coins earned in battle to upgrade your starting weapons and stats. You can start the game with a build tailored to your own playstyle.

games.name: Picronix 3
games.summary:
Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. 

Solve the number clues to reveal hidden pixel art pictures. Solving each row and column brings you closer to the final image.

Enjoy the perfect blend of calm and challenge. A lot unique puzzles await you. They're perfect for a quick break or a long session. 

Train your brain and find your inner peace.

games.name: PiyottoPlanet
games.summary:
Drop × Rotate the Board = A New Merge Puzzles! Play Solo or Battle It Out! Shake the Board, Build Big Chains!

Merge matching pieces to create bigger ones.
Simple rules, with a twist: you can move the board itself.

◆ Spin and Charge Shot Your Way to Total Chaos!
Use gyro controls or buttons to rotate the board
and completely rearrange your carefully stacked pieces.

Then charge up a piece and slam it down with extra force.
The impact can send nearby pieces shifting, turning the board into something completely unexpected.
And from that chaos, new matches and chain reactions can emerge.

▼ Single-Player Modes
Move the board as you take on high-score challenges and Time Attack.
Your scores are added to the leaderboard, where you can compete with players from around the world.

games.name: SAI-KYO-OH! Clash Battle Kings
games.summary:
The "Strongest King Encyclopedia," a series popular among elementary school students through books and anime, is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 as a battle action game!

Control powerful warriors selected from insect, animal, extinct animal, dinosaur, and dragon species and win a chaotic brawl!

Will you take on the challenge alone or battle with friends? Get fired up in two modes!

games.name: Station to Station
games.summary: Station to Station’is a minimalist & relaxing game about building railway connections. Grab your conductor’s hat and bring the voxel-art world to life through the magic of trains!

games.name: Staying at a Japanese Business Hotel
Suicide Guy Deluxe Plus
games.summary:
Sleepin' Guy Deluxe Edition is a first person action-puzzle game set in physics based worlds.
This new enhanced edition includes lots of improvements plus extra contents. You'll assume the role of a nice Big Guy that will need to wake up in order to save the most important thing in his life.

games.name: TANK Z
games.summary: Tank Z is set in a 20XX that a zombie virus has already finished off. What’s left of humanity holds one city – Busan – and what’s left of its firepower is a single prototype tank somebody dug out of an old warehouse. That tank is you.

games.name: The False Alice -Retold Tale- Digital Artbook
The False Alice -Retold Tale- Original Soundtrack
The Spectrum Retreat: Redux
games.summary:
Solve the impossible. Expose the truth. Uncover the secrets of The Penrose Hotel in this atmospheric first person puzzle thriller.

Welcome to The Penrose. Service is impeccable and the rooms are immaculate. You’re its most valued guest, but you can’t remember checking in.

The Spectrum Retreat: Redux is a first-person puzzle thriller created by Dan Smith, Winner of the 2016 BAFTA Young Game Designer Award.

You are Alex. You awaken inside The Penrose, an unsettling art-deco hotel cut off from the outside world. Its corridors are quiet, its staff endlessly attentive, and each day follows a familiar routine. Guided by the voice of a mysterious stranger, you begin searching for the truth about why you are here.

Your escape hinges on solving The Spectrum Retreat’s series of intricate logic and spatial challenges. Absorb and swap colors to slip through security barriers, redirect energy, manipulate your surroundings and rethink the rules of each space. But every puzzle solved brings you closer to something The Penrose would rather keep hidden.

Beneath the hotel’s facade lies a story of memory and grief. You’ll need to decide whether some realities are better left undisturbed.

games.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1 Soundtrack
Tiny Pizza
games.summary:
Take over your uncle’s pizzeria! Mix, bake and master every pizza in this cozy game with adorable animal chefs.

Before you open the doors, there’s one thing to do: discover each recipe, master the art of making it and become the pizza chef you’re meant to be.

Step into a warm, sunny pizzeria, grab a bowl and start combining ingredients to see what delicious creation comes out of the oven.

Pick from a whole shelf of toppings - juicy tomatoes, salami, ham, mozzarella, bell peppers, corn, olives, chili and more. Drop them into the bowl, hit mix and find out if you’ve just cooked up a brand new recipe. Every discovery lands in your recipe book, so your favorites are always close at hand.

Then it’s time for the oven. Keep an eye on the gauge and pull your pizza out at just the right moment - not too pale, not too burnt, just perfectly golden.

New recipes bring experience points. Level up to unlock extra ingredient slots and try bolder, more creative combinations.

With warm hand-drawn art, cute animal chefs and a relaxed pace, Tiny Pizza is a perfect little treat for a quick break, a cozy evening or anyone who has ever dreamed of running their own tiny pizzeria.

games.name: Train Sim World® 7: Cargo Line Vol. 8 - Taschenwagen
Yandere Temptation: Crazy Anime Boys Obsession
games.summary:
He smiles like he loves you. He watches like he owns you. Can you survive a guy who wants you all to himself?

Some guys fall in love. These guys fall obsessed.

Yandere Temptation is a dark visual novel where every tender moment hides something that goes way too far.

Three anime boys. Three kinds of love that cross every line. And you, caught between attraction and something much harder to name, choosing how deep you want to go.

The quiet one who already knows your schedule. The volatile one who loses it when you so much as glance at someone else. The calculated one with a perfect smile and a plan you weren't supposed to find out about.

Each date pulls you further into their world, and every choice feeds something neither of you can fully control.

A companion watches from the outside. They see the red flags you've decided to ignore. They warn you. The rest is on you.

games.name: Yandere Temptation: Crazy Anime Girls Obsession
games.summary:
She smiles like she loves you. She watches like she owns you. Can you survive a girl who wants you all to herself?

Some girls fall in love. These girls fall obsessed.

Yandere Temptation is a dark visual novel where every sweet moment hides something dangerous underneath.

Three anime girls. Three kinds of love that cross every line. And you, stuck in the middle of it all, choosing how deep you want to go.

The quiet one who already knows your schedule. The explosive one who can't stand you looking at anyone else. The perfect one with a plan she hasn't told you yet.

Each date pulls you closer into their world, and each choice you make feeds something you might not be able to stop.

A companion watches it all from the outside. They see the signs. They warn you. Whether you listen is up to you.

games.name: Clash of Crests - The Golden Spurs
GRIME II
games.summary:
Become a stealer of forms in GRIME II, the sequel to 2021's acclaimed action-adventure Metroidvania. You are a Formless - an art mimic, absorbing creatures and summoning molds in their shape.

Venture into a new and mysterious land in the GRIME universe, where danger and wonder await around every corner. Use your surroundings in tandem with your summoned molds to overcome deadly enemies and epic bosses, all the while exploring a deep world full of diverse cultures and characters.

Create your own playstyle by choosing from a variety of abilities, weapons, and mold summons. Learn the makings of your enemies as you summon their form to both aid you in combat, as well as in exploring the various secrets paths of the world.

games.name: Lily Fantasia - FADING LIGHT Song Pack
Magical Rune Tower: Sort the Alchemist Tower
MR. ELEVATOR
games.summary: Hello, I'm Mr. Elevator. Are you seeking a bizarre puzzle game? If you want a game where five people in an elevator explore a strange world drawn like early Windows Paint, listening to odd symbols and sounds to solve mysteries and descend to the deep floors, this is it.

games.name: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration
Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School
Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
Sort It Together - The Cool Pack
Story of The Needle In a Haystack
Tanks & Trebuchets - All Upgrades & Cosmetics Unlocked
Wave & Sort: The Magic Wand Shop
Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
Winx Club - Moonlight Quest: Bloom Cardix Transformation Skin
Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Winx Club – Moonlight Quest is a brand-new video game adventure that allows players to experience the magical universe of Winx Club through exploration, flight, action and a wide variety of mini-games.

Take control of Bloom, transform at will, explore iconic locations from the ground and the skies, master magical powers and uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious Festival of the 100 Moons.

Alongside the main adventure, players can enjoy 32 mini-games across four game modes and play as 24 characters from the Winx Club universe.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told - learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

games.name: Danger Mouse
games.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
games.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

games.name: GrimKeep
games.summary:
The city is lost. From the castle at its center an evil spreads, changing everyone into wretched parodies of life. Desolate streets infested with monsters, perpetually dark skies threaten to spread across the land.

Be the hero, reach the GrimKeep and end the source of evil; the Princess.

In a world of fairy tales turned nightmares, GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder that challenges you to master both luck and strategy. Collect powerful relics, forge unstoppable synergies, and battle through a city consumed by darkness.

games.name: Silly Polly Beast
games.summary: An otherworldly, story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. This is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

games.name: Treachery in Beatdown City: Ultra Remix
games.summary: Treachery in Beatdown City: ULTRA REMIX is a massive story and content update for Treachery in Beatdown City! Tripling the content, Ultra Remix adds new levels, lots of new exciting attacks, defense options, ~80 more enemies to fight, new music, and more!

games.name: Dune: Awakening - Blood and Ice
games.summary:
The Polar Sink map features two distinct biomes: the tundra and the ice cap. Players begin in the tundra, where wealthy water shipper families defend their lavish strongholds. Beyond lies the heavily guarded ice cap, where securing access to ice becomes a central goal.

Equipment built for the desert heat will need upgrading to withstand the cold. With the action returning to the ground, traversal, temperature management, and combat become essential to progression. Resources found only in the Polar Sink will allow players to craft the gear they need to survive.

The new map offers around 35 hours of progression, with opportunities to return for valuable resources. Harvested ice can cool base equipment and speed up production, while the free expansion also introduces new vehicle modules, augments, and specialization traits. Future updates will add further reasons to revisit the region.

games.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.summary:
Get ready for a cozy journey in "Hela", where you'll step into the tiny paws of a brave mouse, the beloved familiar of a witch who needs your help. 

Wander through an enchanting Scandinavian landscape filled with puzzles to solve, potions to brew, and quests to complete, all to aid your ailing witch. Whether you play alone or with friends, you're in for a treat filled with magic, companionship, and loads of charm.

"Hela" offers a delightful mix of adventure and relaxation. Enjoy exploring vast, open spaces, engaging in light-hearted play, and experiencing the simple pleasure of being a part of a caring community.

games.name: Minecraft Dungeons II: The Humblers Awaken
games.summary: The Humblers Awaken DLC brings a fresh adventure to Minecraft Dungeons II, with new quests, unexplored environments, colorful cosmetics, and an expanded arsenal of powerful gear. The Sift is in danger once more, and the humblers – an ancient threat that has slumbered for ages – are beginning to wake up. Turns out they are not particularly happy about it, and if left unchecked, they will spread across the dimension, or worse – stir a much more dangerous foe. It falls on you and your trusty allies to venture into the dimension’s deeper reaches and investigate this strange unrest.

games.name: Plinko Plonko Plunko
games.summary:
Plinko Plonko Plunko is a collection of ball-based arcade games inspired by classic video games. Collide colored balls at the targets to earn Lips that open entry to coolest game of all - Ballceteria.

The aim of Plinko Plonko Plunko is to build up your collection of colored balls that you get to bliss out with in Ballceteria. Shoot, grab, dodge, and pray your way in the games to increase the number of balls in your collection.

Plinko Plonko Plunko is unapologetically bonkers, unbelievably British, and unashamedly tacky. Sometimes if you want something to exist you have to make it yourself.

games.name: The Eternal Castle Remastered
games.summary: The Eternal Castle [REMASTERED] is a remake of the original ETERNAL CASTLE from 1987, with additional game mechanics, sophisticated sound design, polished 2-bit CGA animated graphics, and modernized game design.

games.name: Luma Island
games.summary:
Travel to Luma Island to go on an epic adventure by yourself or with your friends and family. 

Begin your extraordinary journey in a humble old caravan and rise to the grand achievement of building a majestic manor that you can proudly call your home.

Traverse the island solving quests and helping the locals through their struggles. Dangerous spider caves, ancient temples, mind-bending puzzles and hidden treasures await you!

Pick from seven unique in-depth professions each with its own progression path. Upgrade your tools to gather rare materials and collaborate with your teammates to become the masters of your crafts.

games.name: The Ascent: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
The Ascent is a solo and co-op Action-shooter RPG set in a cyberpunk world. 

You play as a worker enslaved by The Ascent Group, a corporate-run metropolis stretching high into the sky and filled with creatures from all over the galaxy. You must take up arms and embark on a new mission to find out what started it all.

games.name: The Falconeer: Revolution Remaster
games.summary:
Take flight in this remastered 'stick control era' aerial combat RPG. Explore haunting landscapes, engage in epic dogfights, and uncover ancient secrets in a visually enhanced, rebalanced edition of the BAFTA-nominated, award-winning original.

You take on the role of Falconeer, a powerful airborne warrior traversing a vast oceanic world torn apart by generations of poisonous decisions and dissent. Throughout multiple campaigns, you will experience life from many different perspectives and loyalties as you embark on a journey of discovery, and solve the mystery of the Ursee, its people and history.

Progress through perilous missions and side quests, wielding your lightning caster to protect ships against pirates, kraken and other threats. Dive through the deep ocean depths, soar above the clouds to do battle with giant crab cities or engage in furious dogfights against the mysterious Mancer Order that controls and regulates technology.

games.name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
games.summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. Framed for murdering the Emperor, villainess Scarlet and Lily, fight the Empire as the first Streamers in history. Capture every enemy and turn them into allies for a happy ending... Or execute everyone and become the Demon Queen!

games.name: The Outer Worlds 2: Side Effects Guaranteed
games.summary:
Side Effects Guaranteed is the first of a two-part narrative DLC experience, and its events will have ramifications in the second installment which is not not guaranteed to be named More Side Effects Guaranteed. So come get your increased level cap, new perks, new flaws, new radio station, and new weapons – not to mention the chance decide the fate of an isolated Protectorate settlement AND the Sub Rosa faction!

That’s right, this DLC is about frightened subjects trying to survive while outlaws of questionable ethics vie for power. What could possibly go wrong?

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary:
Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania focused on fast-paced combat, exploration, and an engaging story. The sequel to Aeterna Noctis follows the steps of its predecessor including a brand new protagonist and a large interconnected world! 

After the events of the first game, the Queen of Light must stop the destruction of the very existence by challenging the Supreme God Chaos while seeking the location of their old nemesis.

games.name: Bloodrush: Undying Wish
games.summary:
Dash, shoot and strike in this lightning-paced hack n' slash roguelike set in a gothic, undying world!

Focused on movement abilities, split-second decision-making and stylish strings of attacks, Bloodrush encourages a creative approach to combat, combining abilities to demolish your foes!

Delve into Death's domain in multiple runs, unlocking the Stranger's vast arsenal of 6 weapons, 10+ combos, 20+ upgrades, and more.

Uncover insights into Death's imprisonment, progressively learning more of her captors' motivations and philosophies at every run.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: E.S.D.E.
games.summary:
Humanity is on the brink of extinction. Most of the population has disappeared, and those who remain have transformed into strange, soulless anomalies creatures that were once human and have now become a terrifying, unknown threat.

Every expedition is a gamble.
One mistake could be your last.

In E.S.D.E., every expedition is a high-stakes gamble. Explore six different zones, from massive apartment complexes to an old school, and recover valuable items that you can sell to merchants to fund your next runs. Face seven types of anomalies, each with unique behaviors.
