games.summary: Run your own hot dog shop in the foggy town of Grimshore. Cook and serve by day, solve your meat shortage by night, and try not to ask too many questions. How far will you go to keep the grill running?

games.name: MECHBORN
games.summary:
Protect Earth and her colonies in a fresh roguelike deckbuilder experience, infusing classic ’90s mech anime with Greek mythology. 

In MECHBORN - YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK - Unlock mech parts and pilots, craft custom decks and unleash devastating combos as you fight to repel the Kaiju incursions!

games.name: Metro Rivals: New York
games.summary:
In a near-future New York City, the Subway system is carved up into ten fiercely competing districts, controlled by Track Titans – larger-than-life celebrity drivers who dominate their line, rake in cash fares and command a massive social following. These high-profile figures rule the rails like underground royalty, fiercely guarding their turf.

You? You’ve got nothing but a hand-me-down train and a dream.

To rise, you’ll need to hustle: complete jobs, get cash, build your following, earn respect - and with it - the prestige to challenge each Titan for their territory. Outwit them. Outdrive them. Outshine them. Only then can you become the undisputed ruler of the underground.

games.name: Nezori
games.summary:
Nezori is a lighthearted action RPG set in a world inhabited by fox girls and wolf girls. 

When the young fox girl Atsuko learns of the legendary hot springs long since forgotten by her people, she sets out on a quest to find it by exploring the territory of the wolf-like Sothiens. 

Atsuko is determined to reach the hot springs, even if it means battling every Sothien who stands in her way. Yet the secrets of their world run deeper than anyone knows, and as she clashes with the Sothiens, her quest might reveal much more than she ever expected.

games.name: No Stone Unturned
games.summary:
It was a dark and stormy morning when the soon-to-be Greatest Detective in the World, Detective Cox, stumbled upon the body of a chicken. (The body was dead, it was a dead body, the chicken was dead and this was his body, found by the Detective who is neither dead or a chicken.) This grisly discovery leaves him with just one question...

...why did the chicken cross the road?

What was he running from? Who, or what, stopped him? And did the chicken really come before the egg? Okay, maybe there's more than one question. But Cox needs answers like a walrus needs a vacation (a lot) - He needs your help (even though he’s incredibly smart, a truly world-class detective and could probably manage without your help, okay?!)

Join Detective Cox as he encounters quirky characters, challenging puzzles, countless mini-games, and a town in disrepair where choices matter but morals don't. 

Will you be leaving... No Stone Unturned?

games.name: OH DEMON! Fix my TV
games.summary: In this horror, comedy, and puzzle game, you will play as a demon summoned by an old woman to fix her television, sending you on an adventure beyond all reason.

games.name: OPUS: Prism Peak
games.summary:
You are a weary, middle-aged photographer, retreating from a life of disappointment in the city to seek solace in your hometown. However, an unexpected turn of events leaves you stranded in an ethereal mountain realm, where you encounter a mysterious girl. To uncover the secrets of this mystical world and find your way back home, you must gather clues and unravel its secrets - with nothing but an old camera in hand.

OPUS: Prism Peak is a narrative-driven adventure game where you play a weary photographer in his autumn years who finds himself caught outside of reality. Using your old camera, you’ll explore an ethereal realm and its ties to the world you left behind, uncover its mysteries, and ultimately find your way home.

games.name: Order 13 VR
games.summary:
Order 13 VR is a psychological horror experience where you work the night shift inside a massive warehouse alongside your cat, your only companion during long nights inside the facility.

Prepare customer orders, organize products, explore dark aisles, and survive increasingly disturbing events as the warehouse slowly transforms into a nightmare.

games.name: Order Up!!
games.summary: Aspiring chefs, get ready to sharpen your knives and put your short order skills to the test in Order Up.

games.name: Out and About
games.summary: A cozy foraging adventure about the magic of real-life plants! Identify and gather wild plants and fungi, cook tasty recipes, master herbal remedies, and rebuild your community after a devastating storm.

games.name: Out of Words
games.summary:
Find your lost voices in a co-op platformer adventure. Together with a friend, via online cross-platform or couch co-op, explore the wild, colorful realm of Vokabulantis as Kurt and Karla in a story about the first time they held hands - where everything you see is crafted by hand.

Solve physics-defying puzzles in ancient catacombs and perform daring stunts among the clay skyscrapers of Nounberg, Out of Words is a journey for two, and this adventure will require cooperation, communication and perfect timing between you and your co-player.

The world is at stake - and so is your relationship. Kurt and Karla become entangled in a battle for the future of Vokabulantis and their friendship itself. Traverse the wonders and dangers of the word of Vokabulantis and falling in love. Kurt and Karla may save this wonderland — but at what cost?

games.summary: Download the @FreeAppADay.com Store App and wish for more top rated apps like Maze+ Race HD to be featured on FAAD! ?
